ModMetaData.name: RimFallout: Automatron
ModMetaData.author: 第九大奇迹泯灭了
ModMetaData.description:
RimFallout新篇章，以《辐射4：Automatron》为灵感，将废土上的机器人、核子可乐与机械大师的故事带到边缘世界。
机器脑与哨兵
研究并培育两种战斗机械族。机器脑以电弧武器和心灵干扰能力压制敌人；哨兵机器人则用机枪与背部集束弹提供重火力支援。
饮料哥与核子可乐
循着广播找回饮料哥，为殖民地添一位热情的饮品伙伴。选择你喜欢的口味，让他生产核子可乐。九种风味，各有不同的饮用效果。 建议搭配Cash Register、Storefront与Gastronomy一起食用，还能让饮料哥参与看管店铺、售卖和餐厅服务，从柜台解放你的殖民者！
机械大师事件链与特殊武器
机械军团正在袭击殖民地。跟随Ada的通讯追踪线索，攻入机械大师的设施，揭开这支机器人军团背后的真相。 在巢穴中寻找保护者凝视、特斯拉步枪与突袭者刀刃。它们既是废土的纪念品，也能成为殖民地的新武器。
搭配RimFallout系列体验更佳。
RimFallout continues with an expansion inspired by Fallout 4: Automatron, bringing wasteland robots, Nuka-Cola and the Mechanist's story to the rim.
Robobrains and Sentry bots
Research and gestate two combat mechs. Robobrains suppress enemies with arc weapons and psychic disruption, while Sentry bots provide heavy firepower with machine guns and back-mounted cluster barrages.
Drinkin' Buddy and Nuka-Cola
Follow a broadcast to find Drinkin' Buddy, an enthusiastic beverage-serving companion for your colony. Choose your favorite flavor and let him produce Nuka-Cola. Nine varieties, each with its own effects. Pair this mod with Cash Register, Storefront and Gastronomy to let Buddy staff shops, sell goods and serve restaurant customers—freeing your colonists from counter duty!
The Mechanist campaign and special weapons
The Automatron faction is raiding your colony. Follow the clues in Ada's transmissions, breach the Mechanist's facility and uncover the truth behind this robot army. Search the lair for Protectron's Gaze, the Tesla Rifle and the Assaultron Blade. These souvenirs of the wasteland can also become new weapons for your colony.
Best enjoyed alongside the other mods in the RimFallout series.
